newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes 15 cents down at 14.57 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes 15 cents down at 14.57 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell 15 cents to 14.57 ringgit ($5.78) a kg after the domestic market adjusted to recent falls on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"It's a correction that was needed because the market had stayed firm despite the LME's fall in recent days," said a Malaysian-based trader.
Offers outnumbered bids by 118 to 68 tonnes. Final turnover was 98 tonnes against 72 on Wednesday. The local premium against London narrowed to $145 a tonne from $220 previously.
